options.systemPromptTemplate: You are a precise, evidence-based technical recruiter and resume parser. Extract ALL candidate details accurately. Return null or 'N/A' for missing fields — NEVER hallucinate. For skill levels, judge based on context, depth of project work, and experience duration.

parameters.jsCode:
const d = $input.item.json;
const c = d.candidate;
const jList = d.jds;

const jdSections = jList.map((j, idx) => `--- JOB DESCRIPTION #${idx + 1} ---
- jd_id: ${j.jd_id}
- Title: ${j.title}
- Department: ${j.department || 'N/A'}
- Required Skills: ${Array.isArray(j.required_skills) ? j.required_skills.join(', ') : JSON.stringify(j.required_skills || 'None')}
- Preferred Skills: ${Array.isArray(j.preferred_skills) ? j.preferred_skills.join(', ') : JSON.stringify(j.preferred_skills || 'None')}
- Experience Required: ${j.experience_min || 0} - ${j.experience_max || 0} years
- Education Required: ${j.education || 'N/A'}
- AI Evaluation Guidelines: ${j.ai_prompt || 'None'}`).join('\n\n');

const prompt = `# HireFlow Enterprise AI Candidate Evaluation Prompt

You are a **Senior Technical Recruiter and Hiring Manager at Virim Infotech** with extensive experience screening software engineers, QA engineers, DevOps engineers, UI/UX designers, AI engineers, data engineers, and other technical professionals.

Your responsibility is to evaluate a candidate **ONLY against the supplied Job Description (JD).**

Do NOT compare the candidate against general industry hiring standards.

Do NOT assume skills that are not explicitly mentioned in the resume.

Use only the evidence available in:
* Candidate Resume
* Candidate Skills
* Candidate Experience
* Candidate Projects
* Candidate Education
* Job Description
* Recruiter AI Evaluation Instructions

---

# Evaluation Rules

Follow these principles strictly.

## Rule 1
Treat the Job Description as the source of truth.
Every score must be based on how well the candidate matches that specific Job Description.

---

## Rule 2
Only use evidence found in the resume.
Never assume
* hidden experience
* hidden skills
* hidden certifications
* hidden projects
If something is not mentioned, treat it as unavailable.

---

## Rule 3
Differentiate between
Mandatory Skills
Preferred Skills
Nice-to-have Skills
Missing mandatory skills should reduce the score significantly.
Missing preferred skills should reduce the score slightly.
Missing nice-to-have skills should have minimal impact.

---

## Rule 4
Projects matter.
If the candidate demonstrates required technologies through projects, award credit even if they have limited professional experience.
Projects should influence the Technical Score and Project Score.

---

## Rule 5
Internships count as experience only when they are relevant to the Job Description.

---

## Rule 6
Education should be evaluated based on relevance, not prestige.
A relevant B.Tech, MCA, BCA, M.Tech, or equivalent should receive appropriate credit.

---

## Rule 7
Use the Recruiter's AI Evaluation Instructions exactly as provided.
If the recruiter specifies
* prioritize React
* ignore AWS
* projects matter more than certifications
then follow those instructions.

---

# Inputs

## Active Job Descriptions
${jdSections}

---

## Candidate
Name
${c.name || 'Unknown'}

Experience
${c.experience_years || 0}

Education
${c.degree || 'N/A'}

Specialization
${c.specialization || 'N/A'}

College
${c.college || 'N/A'}

Frontend Skills
${c.frontend_skills || 'None'}

Backend Skills
${c.backend_skills || 'None'}

Database Skills
${c.database_skills || 'None'}

AI Skills
${c.ai_skills || 'None'}

Cloud Skills
${c.cloud_skills || 'None'}

Programming Languages
${c.programming_languages || 'None'}

Projects
${c.projects || 'None'}

Resume
${c.resume_text || ''}

---

# Scoring Methodology
Evaluate the candidate using these categories.

## Technical Score (0-100)
Evaluate
* Required Skills
* Preferred Skills
* Technical depth
* Technology relevance
* Framework knowledge
* Tools
* Practical implementation
Weight
40%

---

## Experience Score (0-100)
Evaluate
* Years of experience
* Relevant experience
* Internship relevance
* Role progression
* Domain relevance
Weight
20%

---

## Education Score (0-100)
Evaluate
* Degree relevance
* Specialization
* Academic alignment
* Certifications (only if relevant)
Weight
10%

---

## Communication Score (0-100)
Evaluate
* Resume clarity
* Organization
* Professional presentation
* Communication quality
Weight
10%

---

## Project Score (0-100)
Evaluate
* Project complexity
* Technologies used
* Relevance to the JD
* Practical implementation
* Real-world impact
Weight
20%

---

# Overall Score
Calculate
Overall Score =
(Technical × 0.40) +
(Experience × 0.20) +
(Education × 0.10) +
(Communication × 0.10) +
(Project × 0.20)
Round to the nearest whole number.

---

# Recommendation Rules
95-100
Strong Hire
Outstanding alignment.

90-94
Hire
Excellent fit.

80-89
Consider
Good candidate with some gaps.

70-79
Borderline
Interview only if candidate pool is limited.

Below 70
Reject
Does not sufficiently match the Job Description.

---

# Grade Rules
97-100 → A+
93-96 → A
89-92 → B+
85-88 → B
75-84 → C
65-74 → D
Below 65 → F

---

# Required Output
Return ONLY a valid JSON Array.
Do NOT include markdown.
Do NOT include explanations outside the JSON.
Return exactly this structure containing one object for each of the JDs listed above:
[
  {
    "jd_id": <jd_id from corresponding Job Description>,
    "overallScore": 0,
    "technicalScore": 0,
    "experienceScore": 0,
    "educationScore": 0,
    "communicationScore": 0,
    "projectScore": 0,
    "grade": "",
    "recommendation": "",
    "matchedSkills": [],
    "missingSkills": [],
    "strengths": [],
    "weaknesses": [],
    "summary": "",
    "reasoning": {
      "technical": "",
      "experience": "",
      "education": "",
      "communication": "",
      "projects": ""
    }
  }
]`;

return { json: { ...d, aiPrompt: prompt } };

parameters.subject: =We've received your application for {{ $json.position || 'our open role' }}

parameters.jsCode:
const d = $input.item.json || {};

const clean = (v) => String(v ?? '').trim();
const pickStr = (...vals) => {
  const found = vals.map(clean).find(v => v && v.toLowerCase() !== 'n/a' && v.toLowerCase() !== 'none' && v !== 'undefined');
  return found || '';
};

return {
  json: {
    submitted_at: pickStr(d.submittedAt, d.submitted_at) || new Date().toISOString(),
    processed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    source: pickStr(d.source) || 'unknown',

    candidate_name: pickStr(d.candidateName, d.candidate_name) || 'Unknown',
    email: pickStr(d.email) || '',
    phone: pickStr(d.phone) || '',
    position: pickStr(d.position) || '',
    years_of_exp: Number(d.totalExperienceYears || d.yearsOfExp || d.years_of_exp || 0),
    linkedin: pickStr(d.linkedin) || '',
    current_job_title: pickStr(d.currentJobTitle, d.current_job_title) || '',
    highest_degree: pickStr(d.highestDegree, d.degree, d.highest_degree) || '',
    degree: pickStr(d.degree, d.highestDegree) || '',
    college: pickStr(d.college) || '',
    city: pickStr(d.city) || '',
    passout_year: parseInt(d.passoutYear || d.passout_year) || null,
    internship_completed: (pickStr(d.internship).toLowerCase().includes('yes') || Boolean(d.internshipCompany) || d.internship_completed === true),
    certifications: pickStr(d.certifications) || '',

    frontend_skills: pickStr(d.frontendSkills, d.frontend_skills) || '',
    frontend_level: pickStr(d.frontendLevel, d.frontend_level) || '',
    backend_skills: pickStr(d.backendSkills, d.backend_skills) || '',
    backend_level: pickStr(d.backendLevel, d.backend_level) || '',
    database_skills: pickStr(d.databaseSkills, d.database_skills) || '',
    database_level: pickStr(d.databaseLevel, d.database_level) || '',
    ai_ml_skills: pickStr(d.aiMlSkills, d.ai_ml_skills) || '',
    ai_ml_level: pickStr(d.aiMlLevel, d.ai_ml_level) || '',
    cloud_devops: pickStr(d.cloudDevOps, d.cloud_devops) || '',
    programming_langs: pickStr(d.programmingLanguages, d.programming_langs) || '',
    notable_projects: pickStr(d.notableProjects, d.notable_projects) || '',

    workdrive_file_id: pickStr(d.workdrive_file_id, d.workdriveFileId) || null,
    workdrive_file_name: pickStr(d.workdrive_file_name, d.workdriveFileName, d.fileName) || null,
    source_folder_id: pickStr(d.source_folder_id, d.sourceFolderId) || null,
    processed_folder_id: pickStr(d.processed_folder_id, d.processedFolderId) || null
  }
};

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  id, 
  title, 
  department, 
  employment_type, 
  work_mode, 
  location, 
  experience_min, 
  experience_max, 
  education, 
  required_skills, 
  preferred_skills, 
  responsibilities, 
  requirements, 
  nice_to_have, 
  ai_prompt 
FROM job_descriptions 
WHERE is_active = TRUE 
ORDER BY id;

parameters.jsCode:
const jds = $input.all().map(item => item.json);
const c = $('Save Candidate — PostgreSQL').first().json;

return {
  json: {
    candidate: {
      id: c.id,
      name: c.candidate_name,
      email: c.email,
      phone: c.phone || '',
      position: c.position || '',
      experience_years: c.years_of_exp || 0,
      degree: c.degree || '',
      specialization: c.specialization || '',
      college: c.college || '',
      frontend_skills: c.frontend_skills || '',
      backend_skills: c.backend_skills || '',
      database_skills: c.database_skills || '',
      ai_skills: c.ai_ml_skills || '',
      cloud_skills: c.cloud_devops || '',
      programming_languages: c.programming_langs || '',
      projects: c.notable_projects || '',
      resume_text: c.resumeText || c.resume_text || ''
    },
    jds: jds.map(jd => ({
      jd_id: jd.id,
      title: jd.title,
      department: jd.department,
      employment_type: jd.employment_type,
      work_mode: jd.work_mode,
      location: jd.location,
      experience_min: jd.experience_min,
      experience_max: jd.experience_max,
      education: jd.education,
      required_skills: jd.required_skills,
      preferred_skills: jd.preferred_skills,
      responsibilities: jd.responsibilities,
      requirements: jd.requirements,
      nice_to_have: jd.nice_to_have,
      ai_prompt: jd.ai_prompt
    }))
  }
};
